global_module.definition: M := nu_* O_{R_phi}, viewed as a finite O_C- and O_S-module
global_module.obstacle: at a collision of two or more ramification preimages over one carrier point, M is not cyclic and hence is not O_Z for a zero-dimensional subscheme Z

simple_collision.conclusion: even two reduced ramification preimages over one node cannot be represented canonically by a length-two lci direct-image scheme

trace_norm.consequence: trace and norm factor through ordinary reduced point evaluation and do not supply a new linear dependency for CB(|D_l|)
trace_norm.trace_zero_part: stores branch/nilpotent differences but the reduced-value evaluation relevant to Z_red maps diagonally and does not extract a canonical all-nonzero Serre residue vector

jet_residue_wall.issue: when both branch lengths exceed one it is three-generated in the 2-dimensional regular local ring and is not lci; choosing one branch is noncanonical

source_locks.fitting: Stacks tag 07ZA: Fitt_0(M) subset Ann(M), same support; direct sums multiply Fitt_0
source_locks.fitting_schemes: Stacks tag 0C3C: zeroth Fitting subscheme has same underlying support as the module but can be thicker
